playlists.title: Budgeting for Beginners: Simple Budgets That Actually Work
playlists.description: Simple, practical budgeting videos for beginners: the 50/30/20 rule, zero-based budgets, cash envelopes, sinking funds and how to stick to a budget, even on a low income.

playlists.title: How to Save Money: Emergency Fund & Saving Tips
playlists.description: How to save money step by step: building an emergency fund, saving your first $1,000, paying yourself first, automating savings and staying consistent.

playlists.title: Get Out of Debt: Snowball, Avalanche & Credit
playlists.description: Practical ways to pay off debt faster and use credit wisely: debt snowball vs avalanche, credit cards, credit scores and recovering from money mistakes.

playlists.title: Money Habits & Getting Your Life Together
playlists.description: Better money habits and a calmer, more organized life: routines, discipline, goal setting, minimalism and the mindset that makes saving easier.

playlists.title: Grow Your Income: Raises, Side Hustles & Investing Basics
